race.comment: ACHARNEE (2) comes down from NSW, formerly with Bjorn Baker. Now with Reece Goodwin who is going well, she's got the talent to be figuring prominently - watch the betting for a push. ADAKITE (11) is off a let-up but was last seen chasing recent dominant stakes winner Pretty Baby in Adelaide which is great form. If she's forward enough she's well placed. SALARAE (3) resumes for her second campaign and can be an improver for the Cliff Brown yard MO (6) is a well-bred gelding by Extreme Warrior on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard. Jumpouts just fair but very wary for strong connections, market the best guide.
